sentences.text: The petitioner has been arrested in connection with CR No.44/2022 Police Station Sursagar, District Jodhpur for the offence punishable under Sections 376 (D)(A), 376(3), 377 of IPC and Sections 3, 4 (2), 5(G) of POCSO Act.
The present second bail application has been filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C.
The first bail application was dismissed by this Court vide order dated 26.04.2022.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the prosecutrix has been examined before the trial Court as PW-1 and there are material contradictions, improvements and omission.
The accused-petitioner is in judicial custody and the trial of the case will take sufficient long time to be concluded.
Therefore, the benefit of bail should be granted to the accused-petitioner.
[2023/RJJD/007257] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-10941/2022] Learned Public Prosecutor vehemently opposed the bail application filed by the petitioner.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner as well as learned Public Prosecutor and counsel for the complainant.

Dinesh vs State Of Rajasthan (2023/Rjjd/007257) on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82282206/
1
I have considered the arguments advanced before me and gone through the material available on record.

According to the statement of prosecutrix, specific allegation for committing rape has been levelled against the petitioner and the age of the prosecutrix is only fourteen years, therefore, no case for grant of bail is made out.
Hence, the present second bail application filed by the petitioner is hereby dismissed.

(MANOJ KUMAR GARG),J 56-Ishan/-
